title: Verify integrity
description: The integrity blob of every Verify script: the sampled share of tasks (VerifyOptions.SamplingRate) re-executed as a second fan-out and compared with the primary execution on everything an honest node cannot vary (verdict, exit code, outputs, per-case outcomes). A pair that landed on one node is counted, not compared. Empty pairs at rate 0.

compared.description: Pairs whose two sides ran on different nodes.

same_node.description: Pairs whose replica landed on the primary's node (not compared).

unpaired.description: Replicas whose primary result is missing.

mismatch_rate.description: mismatches / compared; 0 when nothing was compared.

pairs.description: One record per sampled task, ordered by index.

differs.description: Present on a mismatch: the fields that differ.
